app.name: Signal Command
app.readOnly: Read-only. HariBatti never controls a signal; an officer approves every change in the real ITMS.

offline.title: The HariBatti API is not reachable
offline.body: Start the local system with `make infra` and `make api` (or `make demo` for the full offline demo). Pages will load again automatically.

login.title: Sign in to Signal Command
login.lead: Enter your official email. We send a 6-digit one-time code; no passwords are stored.
login.devCode: Development mode: the code is {code} (no email service is configured).
login.roles: Roles: Viewer reads everything, Operator also runs Plan Studio and updates citizen reports, Admin also sees the audit log.

common.needsRole: Your role ({role}) cannot do this. Ask an Admin for {need} access.
common.pendingBody: Results appear here automatically once {what} has run.
common.b2: B2 Bypass pair (link to J03 unknown)

metric.healthHelp: 0–100; 100 − (30 wait + 25 clear + 20 starve + 15 ped + 10 spill) penalties.
metric.starvationHelp: Green given ÷ green needed at x = 0.9. Below 0.8 means the approach is starved.
metric.pedHelp: Pedestrian time ÷ time needed at 1.0 m/s (ASSUMED crossing widths). Below 1.0 is unsafe.

overview.title: Corridor overview
overview.lead: Where the Mansarovar corridor loses time, from 24-hour survey counts and the assumed signal plans. Numbers become FIELD once stopwatch timings are collected.
overview.barcodeLead: Each cell is one junction-hour, coloured by Health score. Read across for the daily pattern, down for the corridor at one hour.
overview.schematicNote: Schematic layout – coordinates pending. Spacing 500 m is ASSUMED.
overview.mapNote: Unverified OpenStreetMap candidate positions. Map tiles need internet.
overview.mapOffline: Map tiles could not load (offline?). The schematic works without internet.

live.title: Live wall
live.lead: One tile per junction with every approach's phase and countdown, pushed once a second.
live.noFeed: No live phases yet. Start the simulator with `make sim` (or `make demo`, which starts at the 18:15 PM peak).
live.alertDark: Signal dark: no update for {s} s
live.alertSpill: Spillback: needs queue data (CV pipeline or ITMS)
live.planClock: No live feed right now, so these countdowns run the ASSUMED signal plans on the clock (SIM). Start the simulator (`make sim` or `make demo`) for live phases.

junction.ringNote: Cycle {cycle} s. Greens from the metrics plan for this hour (ASSUMED timing).
junction.cameraNote: No camera feed. The CV pipeline (services/cv) can process a recorded clip: faces and plates are blurred before storage.
junction.lanesAssumed: Lanes marked * are ASSUMED until measured in the field.

audit.title: Fairness audit
audit.lead: Every approach-hour ranked by green starvation: approaches that get less green than they need to clear their queue come first.
audit.fixMore: Give {approach} about {s} s more green at {hour}
audit.exported: Export recorded in the audit log.
audit.fixNote: Suggested fixes are a starting point for a traffic engineer, computed from ASSUMED timing. An officer decides and applies any change in the real ITMS.

plans.title: Plan Studio
plans.lead: Try a signal plan in the SUMO digital twin and compare it with today's assumed plan. Simulation only — nothing is sent to a signal.
plans.running: Simulating… (SUMO runs both plans side by side, about 1–3 min)
plans.tsLead: Green bands along the corridor (J08 → J03). A car driving at the chosen speed follows the diagonal line; where it meets red it must stop.
plans.tsStops: Stops for a car starting at t = 0
plans.tsNote: ASSUMED timing and ASSUMED 500 m spacing.
plans.readOnly: Runs only in the simulator. Nothing is sent to any signal.
plans.idle: Choose two plans and run the simulation. Results are SIM on the schematic network.
plans.noLibrary: The simulator has not been built yet. Run `make sim-build`.
plans.tsOptPending: Optimised offsets appear once the optimisation study has run.

insights.title: ML & models
insights.lead: Every model shows a baseline, a held-out metric and its data size. Simulated results are labelled SIM.
insights.calibrationLead: Share of movement-hours where the simulated count matches the survey (GEH < 5). Target ≥ 85%.
insights.controllersLead: Fixed-time vs Webster vs MaxPressure vs reinforcement learning, in simulation.
insights.forecastLead: 15-min PCU forecasts against seasonal-naive and profile baselines.
insights.anomaliesLead: Junction-hours that behave unlike their usual profile.
insights.cvLead: RT-DETRv2 (Apache-2.0) vehicle detection trained on Indian traffic; mAP on a held-out sample vs a COCO baseline.
insights.trialsChart: Every search trial: calibration day vs validation day (bubble = unserved demand)
insights.trialsNote: Trials are chosen on 11 May only; 12 May is shown for honesty and never used to pick the winner.
insights.controllersMeta: Trained on {train}, evaluated on {evalDay} demand · {window} · {seeds} seeds (mean ± 95% CI)
insights.conformal: Conformal band: ±{width} vehicles per 15 min covered {got} of test slots (target {target}).
insights.injected: On injected test anomalies (movements with ≥ 10 vehicles per 15 min): recall {r}, alarm precision {p} ({a} alarms, {n} injected).
insights.distilled: Plan an officer can key in (distilled from PPO)
insights.phaseChange: Time to the next phase change: a ±{s} s band covered {got} (mean error {mae} s).
insights.dataQuality: Data warning: 12 May correlates {corr} with 11 May and {same} of movement-slots are identical, so 12 May is not an independent test day. Ask the survey agency (data/README.md).
insights.noAnomalies: No unusual movement-slots on 12 May compared with the 11 May profile. That is expected here: the two survey days are almost identical (see the data warning above).

copilot.title: AI Copilot
copilot.lead: Ask about the survey and the metrics in plain English or Hindi. Runs on local Ollama (qwen2.5:7b) with read-only SQL; it always shows the query it ran.
copilot.placeholder: e.g. Which junction had the longest red wait in the evening peak?
copilot.offline: The local model is not running. Start it with `brew services start ollama` and `ollama pull qwen2.5:7b`.
copilot.ex1: Which junction has the lowest health in the evening peak?
copilot.ex2: Show hourly vehicles at J04 on 11 May
copilot.ex3: कौन से जंक्शन पर शाम को लाल बत्ती का इंतज़ार सबसे लंबा है?
copilot.slow: The local model took too long (over 2 minutes). Try a shorter question, or run `ollama run qwen2.5:7b` once to load it into memory.
copilot.unreachable: The copilot request did not reach the API. Check that `make api` is running, then ask again.
copilot.wait: A local model on a laptop usually answers in 20–60 s (the first question after start-up takes longest). Nothing leaves this computer.

reports.title: Citizen reports
reports.lead: Reports from the app: broken, hidden or badly timed signals. Duplicates (same junction and problem) are grouped.
reports.none: No reports yet. They arrive from the HariBatti app.

events.title: Events & green corridor
events.lead: Saved plans for stadium matches, processions and VIP movement, and an ambulance green-corridor planner. Recommendations only.
events.corridorLead: Pick the junctions on the route in order. HariBatti shows when each would need a green hold for the vehicle to pass without stopping.
events.holdAt: Hold green at {j} from about +{s} s
events.assumed: Assumes {speed} km/h and {spacing} m between junctions (ASSUMED spacing).

monthly.title: Monthly report
monthly.lead: Printable summary for the DCP, in English or Hindi. Use Print → Save as PDF.
monthly.noSavings: Not measured yet. Savings appear only after a new plan is applied and an after-period is measured.
monthly.prepared: Prepared by HariBatti (independent project, not affiliated with Rajasthan Police). Generated {date}.

admin.title: Audit log
admin.lead: Every sign-in, export, printed report, Plan Studio run and copilot question.
admin.adminOnly: Only Admins can see the audit log.

connectors.title: Data connectors
connectors.lead: Read-only links to a police ITMS or vendor feed: HTTP polling, WebSocket, MQTT, CSV/Excel drop folder, SAE J2735 SPaT. Map the vendor's junction and arm IDs to ours, then preview before saving.
connectors.adminOnly: Only Admins can manage data connectors.
connectors.readOnly: Connectors only read. HariBatti never sends anything to a signal controller.
connectors.none: No connectors configured. Copy config/connectors.example.yaml to config/connectors.yaml.
connectors.coloursHint: One per line, vendor=OURS, e.g. R=RED, Y=AMBER, G=GREEN
connectors.saved: Saved. The running connector uses it from now on.
connectors.previewLead: Paste a few records (JSON list) or one SPaT message. Nothing is fetched, stored or sent.
connectors.switchHint: Switch the live feed with SIGNAL_SOURCE=<connector id> in .env, then restart the API.

pilot.title: Pilot
pilot.lead: Pilot dates, success measures (baseline vs now), officer notes, weekly reviews and the timing changes you made. Every number shows its source; anything not measured yet says so.
pilot.notStarted: Not started — set the dates when the MoU is signed
pilot.kpiLead: Design goals, not results. Enter a value only when it was measured, with its source.
pilot.weeklyLead: Five questions, once a week. Answers go into the evidence pack.
pilot.q1: On how many days did you open the dashboard this week?
pilot.q3: Did any insight lead to an action?
pilot.q4: What was wrong, missing or confusing?
pilot.q5: How useful was HariBatti this week?
pilot.reviewSaved: Review saved for the week of {date}.
pilot.changesLead: Record a change after you made it in your own system. HariBatti never changes a signal; this log lets us measure before and after.
pilot.notesLead: Notes and pins per junction. Pinned notes stay on top.
pilot.notePlaceholder: What did you see on the ground?
pilot.feedbackLead: Votes from the 👍 / 👎 buttons on every insight card.
pilot.operatorOnly: Operators and Admins can add entries.

evidence.title: Pilot Evidence Pack
evidence.lead: Everything recorded during the pilot, ready to print or save as PDF in English or Hindi.
evidence.placeholders: {n} measures are placeholders: not measured yet. They are shown as such, never estimated.
evidence.reviewsN: {n} reviews · average usefulness {r} / 5 · dashboard used {d} days a week on average

onboarding.title: Onboard an organisation
onboarding.lead: Set up a new customer in a few minutes: organisation, sites, data sources, users, pilot and report template.
onboarding.brandingNote: Branding is the name only. No customer logos without written permission.
onboarding.sitesPolice: Pick junctions from the registry (J01–J08). New junctions cannot be invented.
onboarding.sitesOther: Add the gates or junctions this customer manages.
onboarding.sourcesLead: Where the numbers will come from. Choose SIM only for a demo; every value will carry this label.
onboarding.src_FIELD: FIELD — measured on site (stopwatch, camera, GPS)
onboarding.usersLead: People who may see this organisation. Their permissions follow their sign-in role.
onboarding.datesBoth: Give both dates, or leave both empty.

account.title: My account
account.lead: Your sign-in, and the personal data HariBatti keeps about you (Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023).
account.exportLead: Download everything stored under your email as a JSON file.
account.eraseLead: An Admin anonymises your email in notes, votes, reviews and logs within 30 days, and your account stops working.
account.eraseConfirm: Send an erasure request? This cannot be undone once an Admin completes it.
account.requested: Request #{id} sent. An Admin will handle it within 30 days.
account.signOutLead: Ends this session everywhere; the token is refused from now on.
account.requestsLead: Erasure and correction requests from users. Completing an erasure anonymises the person's email everywhere.
